limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the inverted RAM read enable but also changed the Gray-pointer pipeline, registered the full and empty flags, and added reset gating, altering cycle-level behavior that the one-line fix preserves.
The scoreboard used the DUT’s own flags to decide when transfers occurred and did not independently check when those flags should change, so the rewritten timing passed.
